note: Both sets extract essentially the same 25 table claims from Table 6-1, and every value, unit and row binding I checked is correct in both (e.g., TwSSStif 115.82E+9 N•m2 at 87.60 m/1.0, TwGJStif 307.14E+9 at HtFract 0.3, TwFAStif 246.03E+9 at HtFract 0.6, TMassDen 4885.76 kg/m at 17.52 m/0.2). The only differences are naming conventions (A pairs descriptive names with column codes, B sometimes uses bare codes), which does not change correctness. Both sets equally omit the important prose facts on the page (integrated tower mass 347,460 kg centered at 38.234 m, base diameter 6 m / thickness 0.027 m, top diameter 3.87 m / thickness 0.019 m, Young's modulus 210 GPa, shear modulus 80.8 GPa, effective density 8,500 kg/m3, and the 30% thickness increase). Both also include the same trivial HtFract = 0.9 index claim and several all-zero cg-offset claims.
remarks: Sets A and B are near-duplicates in content; the shared omissions are the prose engineering facts (tower mass/CoM, base and top diameters and thicknesses, Young's and shear moduli, effective density 8,500 kg/m3, 30% thickness scaling). Both include a trivial HtFract index claim and multiple claims of TwFAcgOf/TwSScgOf = 0.0 m, which are correct but of low engineering value. Several attributes are given as bare column codes (TMassDen, TwFAStif, TwGJStif), acceptable here since units and row conditions disambiguate them.
